# Overview

This file conducts the UN1 national analysis, selects County Durham using the accessibility-based criteria, and produces the UN1 + UF1 sensitivity ranking.

## 1. Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(spdep)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

dir.create("data/processed", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cleaned_access_final <- readRDS("data/processed/cleaned_access_final.rds")
lsoa_map <- readRDS("data/processed/lsoa_map.rds")
un1_analytic <- readRDS("data/processed/un1_analytic.rds")
un1_uf1_analytic <- readRDS("data/processed/un1_uf1_analytic.rds")

MIN_TOTAL_LSOA <- 100L
MIN_GROUP_LSOA <- 15L
selected_case_las <- "County Durham"

summarise_dose_response <- function(data, group_var) {
  data %>%
    group_by({{ group_var }}) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      mean_inactivity = mean(inactive_rate),
      median_inactivity = median(inactive_rate),
      sd_inactivity = sd(inactive_rate),
      se = sd_inactivity / sqrt(n),
      t_critical = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
      ci_lower = mean_inactivity - t_critical * se,
      ci_upper = mean_inactivity + t_critical * se,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

cat("UN1 analytical sample:", nrow(un1_analytic), "LSOAs\n")
cat("UN1 + UF1 sensitivity sample:", nrow(un1_uf1_analytic), "LSOAs\n")
```

## 2. National distribution and dose-response

```{r national-distribution}
national_distribution <- un1_analytic %>%
  count(n_low_access_dimensions, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(percentage = n / sum(n) * 100)

print(national_distribution)
```

```{r national-dose-response}
national_dose_response <- summarise_dose_response(
  un1_analytic,
  n_low_access_dimensions
)

print(national_dose_response)

national_trend_model <- lm(
  inactive_rate ~ n_low_access_dimensions_num,
  data = un1_analytic
)

summary(national_trend_model)
```

```{r national-dose-response-plot}
ggplot(
  un1_analytic,
  aes(
    x = n_low_access_dimensions,
    y = inactive_rate,
    fill = n_low_access_dimensions
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.size = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "plasma", direction = -1, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
  labs(
    title = "Economic Inactivity by Number of Low-accessibility Dimensions",
    subtitle = "England, UN1 complete-case LSOAs",
    x = "Number of low-accessibility dimensions",
    y = "Economic inactivity rate"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

ggsave(
  "data/processed/national_dose_response_boxplot.png",
  width = 9,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```

## 3. Candidate ranking and case selection

```{r candidate-ranking}
la_candidates <- un1_analytic %>%
  group_by(la_name) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    pct_2plus = mean(n_low_access_dimensions_num >= 2) * 100,
    pct_3 = mean(n_low_access_dimensions_num == 3) * 100,
    mean_A = mean(mean_access_disadvantage),
    n_dim0 = sum(n_low_access_dimensions_num == 0),
    n_dim1 = sum(n_low_access_dimensions_num == 1),
    n_dim2 = sum(n_low_access_dimensions_num == 2),
    n_dim3 = sum(n_low_access_dimensions_num == 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n >= MIN_TOTAL_LSOA) %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_2plus), desc(n)) %>%
  mutate(
    rank_2plus = row_number(),
    min_group_n = pmin(n_dim0, n_dim1, n_dim2, n_dim3),
    internal_variation_ok = min_group_n >= MIN_GROUP_LSOA
  )

suitable_candidates <- la_candidates %>%
  filter(internal_variation_ok) %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_2plus), desc(n)) %>%
  mutate(rank_suitable = row_number())

cat("Top 15 eligible local authorities by pct_2plus:\n")
la_candidates %>%
  select(
    rank_2plus, la_name, n, pct_2plus,
    n_dim0, n_dim1, n_dim2, n_dim3,
    min_group_n, internal_variation_ok
  ) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15) %>%
  print()

cat("\nTop candidates retaining at least", MIN_GROUP_LSOA,
    "LSOAs in every 0-3 group:\n")
suitable_candidates %>%
  select(
    rank_suitable, rank_2plus, la_name, n, pct_2plus,
    n_dim0, n_dim1, n_dim2, n_dim3, min_group_n
  ) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  print()
```

```{r case-selection}
selected_case_summary <- suitable_candidates %>%
  filter(la_name == selected_case_las)

if (nrow(selected_case_summary) != 1) {
  stop("County Durham is missing from the analytically suitable candidate table.")
}

print(selected_case_summary)

selected_case_distribution <- un1_analytic %>%
  filter(la_name == selected_case_las) %>%
  count(n_low_access_dimensions, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(percentage = n / sum(n) * 100)

print(selected_case_distribution)

stopifnot(
  sum(selected_case_distribution$n) == selected_case_summary$n,
  selected_case_summary$internal_variation_ok
)
```

## 4. England-wide maps

```{r map-preparation}
main_sample_codes <- un1_analytic$lsoa21_code

england_overlap_map <- lsoa_map %>%
  mutate(
    in_main_sample = LSOA21CD %in% main_sample_codes,
    overlap_class = case_when(
      in_main_sample & n_low_access_dimensions_num >= 2 ~
        "2 or 3 low-accessibility dimensions",
      in_main_sample ~ "0 or 1 low-accessibility dimension",
      TRUE ~ "Outside UN1 complete-case sample"
    ),
    overlap_class = factor(
      overlap_class,
      levels = c(
        "Outside UN1 complete-case sample",
        "0 or 1 low-accessibility dimension",
        "2 or 3 low-accessibility dimensions"
      )
    )
  )

selected_case_boundary <- lsoa_map %>%
  filter(la_name == selected_case_las) %>%
  summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry))

if (nrow(selected_case_boundary) != 1 || st_is_empty(selected_case_boundary)) {
  stop("County Durham boundary could not be constructed.")
}

selected_case_map_check <- england_overlap_map %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(la_name == selected_case_las) %>%
  summarise(
    main_sample_lsoas = sum(in_main_sample),
    red_lsoas = sum(
      in_main_sample & n_low_access_dimensions_num >= 2,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )

print(selected_case_map_check)

stopifnot(
  selected_case_map_check$main_sample_lsoas == selected_case_summary$n,
  selected_case_map_check$red_lsoas ==
    selected_case_summary$n_dim2 + selected_case_summary$n_dim3
)
```

```{r map-low-access-overlap}
ggplot(england_overlap_map) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = overlap_class), color = NA) +

    data = selected_case_boundary,

    linewidth = 0.7

ggsave(
  "data/processed/map_low_access_overlap_england.png",
  width = 10,
  height = 12,
  dpi = 300
)
```

## 5. UN1 + UF1 sensitivity ranking

```{r sensitivity-ranking}
la_candidates_sens <- un1_uf1_analytic %>%
  group_by(la_name) %>%
  summarise(
    total_lsoa = n(),
    pct_2plus = mean(n_low_access_dimensions_sens_num >= 2) * 100,
    n_dim0 = sum(n_low_access_dimensions_sens_num == 0),
    n_dim1 = sum(n_low_access_dimensions_sens_num == 1),
    n_dim2 = sum(n_low_access_dimensions_sens_num == 2),
    n_dim3 = sum(n_low_access_dimensions_sens_num == 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(total_lsoa >= MIN_TOTAL_LSOA) %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_2plus), desc(total_lsoa)) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number())

cat("Top 10 sensitivity-ranking local authorities:\n")
la_candidates_sens %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  print()

cat("\nCounty Durham in the sensitivity ranking:\n")
la_candidates_sens %>%
  filter(la_name == selected_case_las) %>%
  print()
```

## 6. Appendix analyses

```{r appendix-combined-score}
la_ranking_composite <- un1_analytic %>%
  group_by(la_name) %>%
  summarise(
    total_lsoa = n(),
    mean_composite = mean(combined_area_disadvantage, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_deprivation = mean(deprivation_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_accessibility = mean(mean_access_disadvantage, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_inactivity = mean(inactive_rate),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(total_lsoa >= MIN_TOTAL_LSOA) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_composite)) %>%
  mutate(rank_composite = row_number())

la_ranking_composite %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  print()

cat("\nCounty Durham in the combined-score ranking:\n")
la_ranking_composite %>%
  filter(la_name == selected_case_las) %>%
  print()

cat("\nUN1 correlation between C and economic inactivity:\n")
print(cor(
  un1_analytic$combined_area_disadvantage,
  un1_analytic$inactive_rate,
  use = "complete.obs"
))
```

```{r appendix-morans-i}
run_moran_mc <- function(sf_data, value_col, nsim = 999L, seed = 1L) {
  usable <- sf_data %>%
    filter(is.finite(.data[[value_col]])) %>%
    st_make_valid()

  nb <- poly2nb(usable, queen = TRUE)
  lw <- nb2listw(nb, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

  set.seed(seed)
  moran.mc(
    usable[[value_col]],
    lw,
    nsim = nsim,
    zero.policy = TRUE
  )
}

un1_map_for_spatial <- lsoa_map %>%
  select(LSOA21CD, geometry) %>%
  inner_join(
    un1_analytic %>%
      transmute(
        LSOA21CD = lsoa21_code,
        inactive_rate,
        n_low_access_dimensions_num
      ),
    by = "LSOA21CD"
  )

national_residuals <- tibble(
  LSOA21CD = un1_analytic$lsoa21_code,
  national_trend_residual = residuals(national_trend_model)
)

un1_map_for_spatial <- un1_map_for_spatial %>%
  left_join(national_residuals, by = "LSOA21CD")

moran_results <- tryCatch(
  list(
    inactivity = run_moran_mc(un1_map_for_spatial, "inactive_rate"),
    dimensions = run_moran_mc(
      un1_map_for_spatial,
      "n_low_access_dimensions_num"
    ),
    trend_residual = run_moran_mc(
      un1_map_for_spatial,
      "national_trend_residual"
    )
  ),
  error = function(e) {
    warning("Moran's I diagnostic was not completed: ", conditionMessage(e))
    NULL
  }
)

print(moran_results)
```
